name: Overclocked Electromancer
oracle_text:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {E}{E}{E}. If you do, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
Whenever this creature attacks, double its power until end of turn.
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, if that creature was dealt excess damage this turn, you get X {E}, where X is that excess damage.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a creature, if that creature was dealt excess damage this turn, you get X {E}, where X is that excess damage.

needs.what: a value (and condition) reading the excess damage (damage beyond lethal, 120.4a) dealt to a damaged creature this turn, readable from a deals_combat_damage trigger whose damaged creature is bound, so the trigger can intervene on excess > 0 and add_energy that amount
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has damage_dealt_to_this_turn and max_damage_taken_this_turn but nothing that subtracts the creature's lethal threshold; the damage op's excess_to only redirects excess from its own damage and is not a readable value; deals_combat_damage exposes no per-creature excess amount
